t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Out of the two colour pairs, one gnome typically gives more mushrooms. Occasionally this will swap so be sure to try the other gnome if you are getting small numbers.

vb_textbox.text: The higher reward is usually on a particular side based on the bonus multiplyer. In my experience the 5x had the higher rewards on the right and the 1x had the higher rewards on the left. Be sure to test out both directions for both multiplyers to earn yourself the most mushrooms.
